bullets: New: Full screen. Press the corners button at the top right. The list and the email preview sit side by side, and View goes to the row and closes full screen.
New: Light and dark mode. Press the sun / moon at the top right; this computer remembers your choice. The email preview keeps the email's own colours.
Changed: The Dev updates bell is only in full screen, right of the name at the top left. A red dot means something new; click the bell to read it. Nothing pops up on its own.
Changed: The Dev Update bell floats again. Drag it anywhere; it starts at the bottom right.

New: When you open Confirmations, it shows what it's reading from the workbook, then asks you to enter your name. Pick yours, or add it if you're new. This computer remembers you for the rest of the day.
New: Your name shows at the top. Use Switch user if someone else takes over.
New: The bell next to Refresh keeps a list of what's changed. Hover over either button to see what it does.
